prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. NO character, portrait, text, letters, numbers, logo, checkerboard, backdrop, pedestal, card, square border or shadow-filled center. Square 1024x1024 canvas. Strict registration: circular photograph opening exactly centered at (512,512), clear diameter 700px; keep all ornament OUTSIDE radius 350px. Outer frame and flourishes contained within radius 490px, no clipping. Rich hand-painted 2.5D fantasy RPG inventory art, crisp beveled metal edges and readable silhouette at 120px. Ember fire theme: sculpted crimson and burnished gold circular armor, flowing orange flame crests and small fire opal gemstones, ember-gold highlights, dark red inner bevel. Strong circular structure, two balanced sweeping flame ornaments, jewel anchor at bottom. Elaborate but leave the face opening large, clean, truly transparent. Consistent frontal view and studio clarity. No neon blob, generic gradient ring, flat vector illustration, nor recreation of an existing game's exact frame. Do not paint any face or fill inside the aperture. Deliver alpha transparency inside AND outside the annulus.
